args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212 (banker's rounding)

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 the service must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `Decimal("2.665")` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: **passed**.

Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Note Decimal("2.675") quantize half-even → 2.68 (since 2.675 is exactly representable in Decimal, half-even rounds to even: 2.68 is even? 8 even → yes 2.68). 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even). Good.
